import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    f = params[3] + params[4]/t + params[5]*t + params[6]*np.sin(params[8]*t) + params[7]*np.cos(params[8]*t) + params[9]*np.exp(-t)
    h = -params[0]*t**params[1]/(t**params[1] + params[2])
    return f + h*A**2
